title: Name the custodian, versioning and change process of the architecture
requirements:
- State where each artefact is published, its version and maintainer
- Name a concrete channel for implementation findings
- Name custodian, versioning scheme and revision cadence; identify the canonical machine-readable home; complete placeholder references and glossary
- Tie each guidance version to a specific model release with change logs
- Describe a learning cycle that collects national blueprints and shares lessons
- Require persistent element identifiers across views and versions
- Require as-built reconciliation of the model with deployed components
